LOOK: Supporters of Vice President Sara Z. Duterte from various regions in Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao, including areas in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao, gradually gather at Rizal Park on San Pedro Street on Saturday, May 9, for the “Inday Sara Duterte 2028 Movement” rally in Davao City.

Organizers described the event as a voluntary and self-reliant initiative led by Duterte’s supporters, carrying the theme “Panaghiusa Para Kay Inday Sara (Unity for Inday Sara),” as participants assembled ahead of the 1 p.m. program for what is expected to be a Mindanao grand rally uniting various groups from across the region.

According to the Mindanao Youth, thousands of participants are expected to attend the grassroots-driven gathering, including local leaders from the BARMM and members of Vice President Duterte’s political network, highlighting continued support and mobilization for her political movement. 

📸 via Ivy Tejano | MB
